What we style

Every event gets its own colour story, materials and layout — nothing off a shelf.
01

Weddings & Mandap Décor

Mandap, entrance, stage and reception styling built around your colour palette — florals, drapes, lighting and seating planned as one look, not separate add-ons.

02

Birthdays & Baby Showers

Backdrop walls, balloon installations and table styling for milestone birthdays, baby showers and welcome ceremonies, sized to your venue and guest count.

03

Corporate & Festive Events

Stage backdrops, entrance décor and festive theming for office celebrations, product launches and seasonal festivals like Diwali and Holi.

04

Home Occasion Styling

Pooja and festival décor, small home celebrations and intimate gatherings — styled without needing a banquet-hall budget.

About Falak Decorations

Décor built around how you'll actually use the space.

We start every booking with a walk-through of the venue and a conversation about how the day will actually move — who arrives where, what gets photographed, what needs to survive till midnight. The styling comes after that, not before it.
